name: bootstrap-orchestrate
description: The /orchestrate skill: delegate one task to a sub-agent of the model and effort you name, in one continuous thread. Invoke-only.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate one task to a sub-agent you choose
interface.longDescription: Name a model and an effort level, and one sub-agent does all the implementation in a single continuous thread while you coordinate and test. Invoke-only: nothing loads it on its own.
defaultPrompt: Use an opus sub-agent with high effort for this task.
Delegate this to a sub-agent and test the result yourself.
